localFacts.fact: Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm: the Befree Live (40 cm folded) and Peak Design (about 39 cm) fit; the AD-01 (89 cm), TP74 (91 cm) and Sachtler (86 cm) need to be checked.
Barcelona City Council's basic permit for filming or photographing in public space covers one tripod at most and a maximum of 10 people, with no vehicles or drones during the shoot.
Sagrada Familia rules say tripods may not be used for video inside the basilica.
Spanish terms: rotula fluida / cabezal fluido, media bola de 75 mm, contrapeso, arana intermedia; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Rated loads are optimistic once the camera moves; a rig with cage, mic and cables needs far more headroom.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the rig under half the head's rating (English post rule): caged FX3 to the 6 kg AD-01 head or 8 kg TP74.
